intro: New York runs elections county by county, through each county board of elections, with the State Board of Elections overseeing the state.

id_rule.text: Most registered voters do not need to show ID. You need ID only if you are a first-time voter who did not give a driver's license number, non-driver ID number, or last four Social Security digits when you registered. If you have none, you can vote by affidavit ballot.
